title: Film set magic
paragraphs: From painted foam pieces resembling delicious feasts to engineered weather, the magic of film relies on hidden details unknown and usually invisible to the unsuspecting viewer. So, let's explore some of the most fascinating behind-the-scenes tricks of the big screen.

Screen trickery and cinematic illusions are a huge part of what brings stories to life, and set is key to this. Consider period dramas like Sherlock and Peaky Blinders – both TV programmes changed modern street furniture like lampposts and signs by covering them up with facades or temporary structures. Cobbled streets, a staple of many historical dramas, can be created using plastic or rubber floor tiles, which are lightweight and therefore quick to lay down and remove.

But sometimes it's not just part of a set that's made, but the entire thing. A team of 86 artists and model makers built an incredibly detailed miniature model of Hogwarts, the wizarding school in the Harry Potter series. It was easier to create this than to build a real castle, and was especially used for sweeping shots of the castle's exterior.

It's even possible to control the weather. Filmmakers creating a rain scene generally don't use real rain, partly because you can't control it, but also because natural rain doesn't show up on camera very well. This is because the water droplets are too small, so rain machines that create bigger droplets are often used. Combine that with a dramatic backlight and the rain will glisten on screen. This was likely a technique used in The Matrix, possibly alongside CGI, in the final fight scene between Agent Smith and Neo, which takes place in a torrential downpour.
So next time you're watching a movie, remember the movie magic – you can't believe everything you see!

vocabulary.translation: 测试被设计成产生特定的结果。

vocabulary.entry: **unsuspecting** /ˌʌnsəˈspektɪŋ/ adj. 不怀疑的，无戒备心的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The scam targeted unsuspecting internet users.
vocabulary.translation: 这个骗局针对的是毫无戒备心的互联网用户。

vocabulary.entry: **fascinating** /ˈfæsɪneɪtɪŋ/ adj. 极有吸引力的，迷人的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The documentary offered a fascinating insight into the artist's life.
vocabulary.translation: 这部纪录片对艺术家的生活提供了引人入胜的了解。

vocabulary.example: The book gives a behind-the-scenes look at the film industry.
vocabulary.translation: 这本书提供了对电影工业的幕后观察。

vocabulary.example: The magician's performance was full of clever trickery.
vocabulary.translation: 魔术师的表演充满了巧妙的把戏。

vocabulary.entry: **cinematic** /ˌsɪnəˈmætɪk/ adj. 电影的，电影制作的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The film has a very cinematic quality.
vocabulary.translation: 这部电影具有很强的电影质感。

vocabulary.example: The mirror creates the illusion of more space.
vocabulary.translation: 镜子制造出空间更大的错觉。

vocabulary.example: The film's sets were incredibly realistic.
vocabulary.translation: 这部电影的布景极其逼真。

vocabulary.entry: **period drama** /ˈpɪəriəd ˌdrɑːmə/ n. 时代剧，古装剧（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: She loves watching British period dramas.
vocabulary.translation: 她喜欢看英国时代剧。

vocabulary.example: The lamppost was covered in posters.
vocabulary.translation: 路灯柱上贴满了海报。

vocabulary.entry: **facade** /fəˈsɑːd/ n. （建筑物的）正面，假立面（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The building's facade was beautifully decorated.
vocabulary.translation: 建筑物的正面装饰得很漂亮。

vocabulary.example: They are looking for temporary office staff.
vocabulary.translation: 他们正在寻找临时的办公室职员。

vocabulary.example: The old town has narrow, cobbled streets.
vocabulary.translation: 老城区有狭窄的鹅卵石街道。

vocabulary.entry: **staple** /ˈsteɪpl/ n. 主食，主要成分（此处引申为标配）
vocabulary.example: Rice is a staple of the local diet.
vocabulary.translation: 大米是当地饮食的主食。

vocabulary.entry: **floor tile** /ˈflɔː taɪl/ n. 地砖（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: The kitchen floor is covered with ceramic floor tiles.
vocabulary.translation: 厨房地板铺着瓷砖。

vocabulary.example: The suitcase is made of a lightweight material.
vocabulary.translation: 这个手提箱是用轻质材料制成的。

vocabulary.entry: **lay down** /ˌleɪ ˈdaʊn/ phr. v. 铺设，放下（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: They are laying down new tracks for the railway.
vocabulary.translation: 他们正在铺设新的铁路轨道。

vocabulary.example: The video was removed from the platform.
vocabulary.translation: 该视频已从平台上移除。

vocabulary.example: The process is incredibly complex.
vocabulary.translation: 这个过程极其复杂。

vocabulary.entry: **miniature** /ˈmɪnətʃə(r)/ adj. 微型的，小型的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She collects miniature dolls for her doll's house.
vocabulary.translation: 她为她的玩偶之家收集微型娃娃。

vocabulary.entry: **wizarding** /ˈwɪzədɪŋ/ adj. 魔法的，巫师的（虚构词）
vocabulary.example: The wizarding world of Harry Potter is full of magic.
vocabulary.translation: 哈利·波特的魔法世界充满了魔力。

vocabulary.example: The film ends with a sweeping shot of the city.
vocabulary.translation: 电影以一个城市的全景镜头结束。

vocabulary.translation: 房子的外墙需要粉刷。

vocabulary.translation: 窗户上布满了水珠。

vocabulary.example: The photographer used a backlight to create a silhouette.
vocabulary.translation: 摄影师使用背光来制造剪影效果。

vocabulary.example: Her eyes glistened with tears.
vocabulary.translation: 她的眼睛泪光闪闪。

vocabulary.entry: **torrential** /təˈrenʃl/ adj. 倾盆的，如注的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The rain was torrential, and we got soaked.
vocabulary.translation: 下着倾盆大雨，我们都被淋湿了。

vocabulary.example: We got caught in a sudden downpour.
vocabulary.translation: 我们突然遇到了倾盆大雨。

vocabulary.entry: **CGI** /ˌsiː dʒiː ˈaɪ/ n. 电脑生成图像，计算机特效（computer-generated imagery，专业术语）
vocabulary.example: The movie used CGI to create the dinosaur scenes.
vocabulary.translation: 这部电影使用电脑特效来制作恐龙场景。

sentences.english: From painted foam pieces resembling delicious feasts to engineered weather, the magic of film relies on hidden details unknown and usually invisible to the unsuspecting viewer.
sentences.chinese: 从看似美味盛宴的彩绘泡沫道具到人工操控的天气，电影的魅力依赖于那些隐藏起来不为人知的细节，这些细节深信不疑的观众也看不见。

sentences.english: So, let's explore some of the most fascinating behind-the-scenes tricks of the big screen.
sentences.chinese: 那么，让我们来探索一些大银幕最迷人的幕后机关吧。

sentences.english: Screen trickery and cinematic illusions are a huge part of what brings stories to life, and set is key to this.
sentences.chinese: 银幕欺骗花招和电影幻象是让故事栩栩如生的很大一部分原因，而布景是关键。

sentences.english: Consider period dramas like Sherlock and Peaky Blinders – both TV programmes changed modern street furniture like lampposts and signs by covering them up with facades or temporary structures.
sentences.chinese: 想想《神探夏洛克》和《浴血黑帮》这样的时代剧——这两部电视剧都通过用幕墙或临时结构覆盖灯柱和指示牌等现代街道设施来改变它们。

sentences.english: Cobbled streets, a staple of many historical dramas, can be created using plastic or rubber floor tiles, which are lightweight and therefore quick to lay down and remove.
sentences.chinese: 许多历史剧的主要部分——鹅卵石街道，可以使用塑料或橡胶地砖来制作，这些地砖重量轻，因此铺设和拆除都很快。

sentences.english: But sometimes it's not just part of a set that's made, but the entire thing.
sentences.chinese: 但有时制作的不是布景的一部分，而是整个布景。

sentences.english: A team of 86 artists and model makers built an incredibly detailed miniature model of Hogwarts, the wizarding school in the Harry Potter series.
sentences.chinese: 一个由86名艺术家和模型制作师组成的团队制作了一个细节极其丰富的霍格沃茨微缩模型，即《哈利·波特》系列中的魔法学校。

sentences.english: It was easier to create this than to build a real castle, and was especially used for sweeping shots of the castle's exterior.
sentences.chinese: 制作这个模型比建造一座真正的城堡更容易，这个模型被专门用来拍摄城堡外景的广角镜头。

sentences.english: It's even possible to control the weather.
Filmmakers creating a rain scene generally don't use real rain, partly because you can't control it, but also because natural rain doesn't show up on camera very well.
sentences.chinese: 拍摄雨景的电影制作人通常不会使用真实的雨，部分原因是你无法控制它，还因为自然雨在镜头中显示得不太好。

sentences.english: This is because the water droplets are too small, so rain machines that create bigger droplets are often used.
sentences.chinese: 这是因为水滴太小，所以经常使用能制造更大水滴的造雨机。

sentences.english: Combine that with a dramatic backlight and the rain will glisten on screen.
sentences.chinese: 再结合戏剧性的背光，雨就会在屏幕上闪闪发光。

sentences.english: This was likely a technique used in The Matrix, possibly alongside CGI, in the final fight scene between Agent Smith and Neo, which takes place in a torrential downpour.
sentences.chinese: 这很可能是《黑客帝国》中使用的一种技巧，可能还与电脑特效一起用在史密斯探员和尼奥之间的最后一场打斗场景中，那场戏发生在倾盆大雨中。

sentences.english: So next time you're watching a movie, remember the movie magic – you can't believe everything you see!
sentences.chinese: 所以下次你看电影时，记住电影魔法——你别相信你看到的一切！
